verdict.rationale: Shopify Agentic Commerce is the server side of agentic commerce: UCP MCP servers (Catalog, Cart, Checkout, Order), a CLI, and webhooks that external AI agents consume. Plugging third-party MCP servers into it as a client is a different product role. Nothing in the evidence shows it acting as an MCP client or host, so the story is a category error rather than a missing capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
